status: SIM 2026-11-04: the simulated TABLETOP's stops (DEV, not frozen). Written by `python -m sim.tabletop positions`.
note: Frame: configs/sim/tabletop_geometry.json (origin at the workspace centre on the table top, y away from P3). Lens on a 45 cm arc about the workspace centre, 38 cm above the table, azimuths -60..60 deg in 30 deg steps, each stop facing the centre, roll 0. Each stop's tilt_deg (downward pitch) maximises the smallest frame margin of the workspace outline (24 points on the 0.20 m circle at z = 0 and z = 0.12) with the fitted k1; accepted only if every stop's acceptable-pitch window (margin >= 0) is >= 2 deg wide. There is no file-level tilt_deg: readers use the per-stop values (sim/rig.py stop_tilt_deg).
arc_centre_note: the arc centre is the frame origin (the workspace centre); the key name is the shelf schema's
height_note: lens height above the table top (z = 0)
roll_note: every stop; read by sim/rig.py cameras_from_positions (the shelf file has no roll_deg and keeps the P3 fitted 1.98 deg)

revisit_check.method: worst outline margin over the 64 corners of the +-translation (world x, y, z) / +-rotation (yaw, pitch, roll) box (sim/arrange.py perturb_camera), and over a seeded uniform sample (revisit_draw, entropy [7000000 + k], k < 2000, stream_salt 1383428169, attempt 0); expected_redraw_rate = the sample's share below min_margin_px. The arrangement frame check will add the target's hull (sim/arrange.py frame_check).

acceptance.rule: every stop's k1 acceptable-pitch window >= 2.0 deg

provenance.plan: design proposal section 2 = the recorded D2b tabletop plan (DECISIONS 2026-09-26 evening); researcher's decision 2026-11-04 item 1
